entries.subject: the Buddha
entries.object: staying near Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove

spans.text: At one time the Buddha was staying near Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.

entries.task_id: uggāhamāna samaṇamaṇḍikāputta|was|residing together with around five hundred wanderers in mallikā’s single-halled monastery for philosophical debates
entries.description: Uggāhamāna Samaṇamaṇḍikāputta was residing together with around five hundred wanderers in Mallikā’s single-halled monastery for philosophical debates
entries.subject: Uggāhamāna Samaṇamaṇḍikāputta
entries.object: residing together with around five hundred wanderers in Mallikā’s single-halled monastery for philosophical debates

spans.text: Now at that time the wanderer Uggāhamāna Samaṇamaṇḍikāputta was residing together with around five hundred wanderers in Mallikā’s single-halled monastery for philosophical debates, hedged by pale-moon ebony trees.
